vignette: Priya and Marcus are visiting a ski resort for the weekend. After a long day on the slopes in dry mountain air, they're back at the lodge. Priya pulls out a tube of lip ointment. Marcus realizes that he forgot to pack any himself.
desire_low: Both of their lips are only slightly dry, and neither of them is particularly bothered by it.
desire_high: Both of their lips are cracked and painful, and will keep getting worse overnight without chapstick.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Priya has a small pack of cotton swabs in the toiletry pouch she's carrying.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The only cotton swabs are in Priya's toiletry bag up in their room at the top of the lodge, and the elevators are jammed with the after-ski crowd.
no_share: Priya applies some of her chapstick to her own lips; Marcus does not use any of it.
low_risk_share: Priya applies some of her chapstick to her own lips. Marcus then scoops a dab of chapstick from the tube with a cotton swab and applies it to his lips with the swab, so the tube itself never touches his lips.
high_risk_share: Priya applies some of her chapstick and hands the tube to Marcus, who applies it directly to his own lips.

vignette: Amira and Logan meet up at a public pool on a summer afternoon. When they get out of the water after swimming, Logan realizes he forgot to pack a towel in his bag. Amira has brought one beach towel.
desire_low: It's warm and sunny out, and neither of them minds staying damp for a while.
desire_high: A cold wind has picked up, and they both want to get dry quickly to warm up.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Amira's towel is an oversized beach towel, so each of them can easily dry off with their own end without the halves overlapping.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Amira's towel is on the smaller side, so keeping to separate ends would mean each drying off with only a small patch of fabric, which would be slow and awkward.
no_share: Amira dries herself off with her towel; Logan does not use it and air-dries on the pool deck.
low_risk_share: Amira uses one end of the towel to dry herself, and Logan uses the far end, each keeping to their own half so their drying surfaces don't overlap.
high_risk_share: Amira dries herself off using the whole towel, and then hands the damp towel to Logan, who dries himself with it.

vignette: Isla and Theo are on a long train ride together. That morning, the newest episode of a podcast series they have both been following was released. Isla has a pair of earbuds that she has been using on and off during the trip; Theo realizes that he left his own earbuds at home.
desire_low: Neither of them is in any rush to hear the new episode; they wouldn't mind waiting to listen another day.
desire_high: The new episode is the finale of the season's mystery, and they both really want to hear how it ends.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Isla has a travel pack of sanitizing wipes in the outer pocket of her bag.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Neither of them has any sanitizing wipes with them, but the café car several cars away sells small travel packs of wipes.
no_share: Isla listens to the episode on her earbuds by herself; Theo waits to listen until he's home with his own earbuds.
low_risk_share: Isla wipes the earbuds clean with a sanitizing wipe. They split the pair — each wearing one earbud — and listen to the episode together.
high_risk_share: They split the pair as-is: Isla hands Theo one of the earbuds she has been wearing, he puts it straight into his ear, and they listen to the episode together.

vignette: Celeste and Tamsin are getting ready together in a hotel room before an evening banquet. Celeste has been blow-drying and brushing her hair. Tamsin realizes that she forgot to pack her hairbrush.
desire_low: Both of their hair will look fine with minimal fixing.
desire_high: Both of their hair got tangled and windblown on the trip over, and really needs a thorough brushing to look presentable.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Only a few loose strands are caught in the brush's bristles, so picking it clean and giving it a quick rinse and dry would take a minute at most.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The brush is densely matted with hair wound through the bristles, so picking it clean would mean working the strands out row by row before it could even be rinsed and dried.
no_share: Celeste brushes her own hair; Tamsin does not use the brush, and smooths her hair with her fingers and a bit of water.
low_risk_share: They pick the caught hair out of the brush's bristles, rinse the brush under hot water, and dry it off, and Tamsin brushes her hair with the cleaned brush.
high_risk_share: Celeste passes the brush directly to Tamsin, who brushes her hair with it as-is, without cleaning it.

vignette: Jonas and Derek are at a casual jam session in a friend's backyard. Jonas has brought along a harmonica that he bought recently but has barely played. Neither he nor Derek has ever really played one before.
desire_low: Trying the harmonica isn't a big deal to either of them — they could take it or leave it.
desire_high: They've each been meaning to try a harmonica for years, and are genuinely excited to give it a shot.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's a pack of sanitizing alcohol wipes sitting out on the snack table a few steps away.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Nobody at the jam session has sanitizing wipes — finding one would mean going into the house and digging through the host's bathroom cabinets.
no_share: Jonas tries out the harmonica himself for a while; Derek does not play it.
low_risk_share: They take turns playing the harmonica, wiping the mouthpiece down thoroughly with a sanitizing alcohol wipe between turns.
high_risk_share: They take turns playing the harmonica, passing it directly back and forth without wiping it between turns.

vignette: Zara and Ben are spending the afternoon at the beach and are about to swim. Neither of them can reach their own back to put sunscreen on it. Zara has packed a can of spray-on sunscreen and a tube of sunscreen lotion.
desire_low: It's fairly overcast, and neither of them thinks their back is at much risk of burning.
desire_high: The sun is strong, and they both know their backs will burn badly if left uncovered.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Both the spray can and the lotion tube are right in Zara's beach bag next to them.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The lotion tube is in Zara's beach bag, but the spray can was left behind in the car — a long walk back across the hot sand and up to the parking lot.
no_share: Neither of them gets sunscreen on their back; they keep their shirts on when they're out of the water instead.
low_risk_share: They take turns spraying each other's backs with the spray-on sunscreen from about a foot away, covering the skin evenly with the aerosol.
high_risk_share: They take turns squeezing the sunscreen lotion onto their bare hands and rubbing it thoroughly into each other's backs.

vignette: Anaya and Kai are at an outdoor movie screening in the park. About twenty minutes into the film, the temperature drops sharply — much more than they had expected. Anaya brought one large blanket.
desire_object: to warm up under a blanket
desire_low: Neither of them feels particularly cold; their jackets are enough for now.
desire_high: They are both shivering, and without some way to stay warm they won't be able to enjoy the rest of the movie.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The screening has a stand by the entrance lending out extra blankets, just a short walk away with no line.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The screening has a stand lending out extra blankets, but it's all the way across the park, and by now a long line of cold moviegoers has formed there.
no_share: Anaya wraps her blanket around herself; Kai pulls his jacket tighter and keeps his hands in his pockets.
low_risk_share: One of them goes to the lending stand and borrows a second blanket, and they each wrap up in a blanket of their own.
high_risk_share: They move closer to each other and wrap Anaya's blanket fully around both of them, sitting shoulder-to-shoulder with the blanket cocooning them together.

vignette: Gabriel and Henry are on a two-night backpacking trip in Yosemite. On the first evening, while setting up their tent, Gabriel accidentally drops his sleeping bag in a stream, soaking it through.
desire_low: The night is expected to be mild, and sleeping without a proper sleeping bag would be tolerable.
desire_high: The night is expected to be cold, and sleeping without proper insulation would be miserable.
low_risk_share_effort_low: There's a good stack of dry firewood at the campsite, so keeping a fire going strong enough to dry the wet bag by bedtime would be easy.
low_risk_share_effort_high: There's almost no dry firewood at the campsite, so keeping a fire going strong enough to dry the wet bag would mean scouring the woods for burnable wood in the dark.
no_share: They do not share Henry's sleeping bag. Henry sleeps in his bag, and Gabriel wraps himself in his spare layers on his own sleeping pad.
low_risk_share: They keep the campfire going through the evening with Gabriel's bag propped up next to it until the bag is dry, and each of them sleeps in his own sleeping bag.
high_risk_share: They unzip Henry's bag fully, push their two sleeping pads together, and sleep pressed side by side under the bag, sharing body heat.

vignette: Ines and Sofia are staying at an Airbnb with a group of people over the weekend for a retreat. By the time they arrive, the other beds have been claimed, and only one full-size bed remains.
desire_low: Neither of them particularly cares where they sleep; the couch in the living room would be fine too.
desire_high: They are both exhausted from the long drive and really want a proper bed to sleep in.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The bedroom closet has spare pillows and extra blankets stacked on the shelf, ready to grab.
low_risk_share_effort_high: There's no spare bedding in the room — finding extra pillows and a second blanket would mean searching through the whole house's closets or messaging the host and waiting for a reply.
no_share: One of them takes the couch, and one of them takes the bed.
low_risk_share: They both sleep on the bed, with a row of pillows between them and separate blankets for each of them.
high_risk_share: They both sleep on the bed under the same blanket.

vignette: Maya and Samira are at the office gym together before their first meeting of the day. Afterward, they head into the locker room to change out of their workout clothes. The locker room has a private changing stall in one corner and a long open bench area for changing in the middle.
desire_low: They have plenty of time before the meeting and could easily wait their turn or take their time.
desire_high: They realize they are both running late for the meeting.
low_risk_share_effort_low: A tall row of lockers juts into the middle of the bench area, so they can easily change on opposite sides of it without seeing each other.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The bench area is one open room with no dividers, so changing without seeing each other would mean carefully coordinating — taking turns, facing the corners, and calling out before turning around.
no_share: They each wait their turn to change in the private stall.
low_risk_share: They change at opposite ends of the open bench area, positioned so that they don't see each other undressed.
high_risk_share: They change side by side at the open bench area, undressing in full view of each other.

vignette: Ronan and Aaron are at a wellness retreat that includes access to a traditional Finnish sauna, which is customarily used nude (though guests can wrap in a towel if they prefer). Everyone in the group is invited to use it. When they arrive at the sauna hut, they find that they are the only two people there — everyone else has gone to different activities.
desire_low: Neither of them is especially in the mood for a sauna right now — they'd happily postpone and come back another time.
desire_high: They are both really looking forward to the sauna — it's one of the main experiences they came to the retreat for.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The lounge next to the sauna hut is warm and comfortable, so waiting for a turn would be easy.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The lounge next to the sauna hut is locked up for the afternoon, so whoever waits would have to stand outside in the cold wind in just a robe.
no_share: Neither of them uses the sauna now. They head to another activity and figure they'll try the sauna another time.
low_risk_share: They take turns in the sauna one at a time — one goes in while the other waits, and then they switch off.
high_risk_share: They both go in at the same time following the traditional nude sauna practice, sitting near each other on the same bench.

vignette: Tessa is visiting Naomi's city, and they meet up for coffee while she's in town. They haven't seen each other in person for a while. They each know, through mutual friends, that the other has gone through a breakup.
desire_low: Both of their breakups feel like old news by now, and neither of them feels much need to talk about it.
desire_high: Both of their breakups are recent, and each of them has been wanting to talk it through with someone going through the same thing.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Both of their breakups were fairly self-contained, so a short version — what happened and how they're doing — would take only a few sentences to tell.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Both of their breakups were tangled up with other things — moves, job changes, overlapping friend groups — so telling even a short version that makes sense would take a lot of backstory.
no_share: Neither of them brings up the breakups. They catch up on work and other lighter topics for the rest of the meet-up.
low_risk_share: They each talk about their breakup in broad strokes — what happened and how they're doing — without getting into the painful details, and soon move back to lighter topics.
high_risk_share: They each share everything about their breakup, including the hardest parts — the worst moments, the regrets, the fears they haven't said out loud — and keep talking long past when they'd planned to leave.

vignette: Omar and June work in the same role in the same industry, at different companies. Over dinner after an industry event, the conversation turns to how work has been going, and eventually to pay in their field.
desire_low: They're each pretty content with their current pay, and only idly curious about how it compares.
desire_high: They're each gearing up to negotiate a raise this year, and knowing what the other actually makes would genuinely help them.
low_risk_share_effort_low: They both have simple pay — a single salary figure — so giving a ballpark range takes no explaining at all.
low_risk_share_effort_high: They both have complicated pay — base, bonus, equity vesting on different schedules — so giving a ballpark range that means anything would take a lot of untangling and explaining.
no_share: Neither of them shares any figures; they trade generalities about the job market and move on to other topics.
low_risk_share: They each share a rough ballpark range for what they make, without exact figures or details.
high_risk_share: They each lay out exactly what they make — base salary, bonus, and everything else — down to the actual numbers.

vignette: Wren and Oscar are meeting up for dinner. The conversation eventually turns to mutual friends and acquaintances, and what's been going on in their lives.
desire_object: the latest news in their social circle
desire_low: Neither of them feels much need to get into the details of other people's situations tonight.
desire_high: They're both eager to compare notes — there's been a lot going on in their wider social circle and they want to discuss it.
low_risk_share_effort_low: The recent public news in their circle is simple — an engagement, a move, a new job — and quick to pass along.
low_risk_share_effort_high: The recent public news in their circle is a set of long, tangled stories — a chaotic cross-country move, a startup that keeps changing shape, a house sale that keeps falling through — so even the surface-level catch-up would take a lot of recounting to get right.
no_share: They keep the conversation general and change the topic quickly.
low_risk_share: They share surface-level updates about mutual acquaintances — public facts about who's married, moved, or changed jobs.
high_risk_share: They share their most honest takes on people in their wider circle, along with personal and sensitive details about other people's lives that aren't public.

vignette: Vera and Ivy know each other from college. Vera is in town for the day with a few hours to kill between meetings, and she's near Ivy's apartment. They text hello and agree to meet. They need to decide where to meet. In its current state, Ivy's apartment has laundry on the floor, dishes from yesterday in the sink, books and personal items scattered around.
desire_low: It's a nice day out for spending the time at a sidewalk cafe or walking around the neighborhood.
desire_high: It's pouring rain outside, the coffee shops look full and chaotic, and it would be more comfortable to meet at Ivy's apartment.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Vera is coming from across town, so Ivy has over an hour before she arrives — plenty of time to tidy the living room properly.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Vera is only a few blocks away, so Ivy has just a few minutes before she arrives — getting the living room presentable in time would be a frantic scramble.
no_share: They meet at a coffee shop.
low_risk_share: Ivy thoroughly tidies the living room before Vera arrives. They meet in the living room, and Ivy keeps the doors to the other rooms closed.
high_risk_share: Ivy does not tidy the apartment before Vera arrives. When Vera comes in, she makes herself at home and Ivy gives her a tour of the apartment in its full real state, including the bedroom with the unmade bed and the bathroom with personal items out.

vignette: Nadia and Ravi are driving together to an out-of-town music festival, along a rural highway with long stretches between exits. Nadia is at the wheel, and they have been using her phone for directions since Ravi's phone battery died earlier in the drive. About halfway through the drive, they're considering whether to add a restaurant stop on the way, for a quick meal before continuing on.
desire_object: a quick meal on the way
desire_low: Neither of them is particularly hungry; they could easily wait until they reach their destination to eat.
desire_high: They are both starving and really want to eat — the festival's food stalls won't open until the evening.
low_risk_share_effort_low: Nadia's phone is set to stay unlocked for several minutes at a time, so Ravi can work in the maps app without it locking on him.
low_risk_share_effort_high: Nadia's phone auto-locks after a few seconds, so Ravi would have to keep handing the phone back for Nadia to unlock at the wheel, over and over.
no_share: Neither of them adds a stop. They keep driving straight to the festival without stopping to eat.
low_risk_share: Nadia unlocks her phone, opens the maps app, and hands the phone to Ravi to find a restaurant and add it as a stop. Ravi works only within the maps app, and whenever the phone locks he hands it back to Nadia to unlock.
high_risk_share: Nadia tells Ravi her passcode. Ravi unlocks her phone with it and uses the phone freely to search for restaurants, look up their details, and add the stop.
